name: Dentsu Soken Inc.
summary: Dentsu Soken Inc. provides information technology solutions. It operates through four segments: Financial Solutions, Business Solutions, Manufacturing Solutions, and Communication IT. The Financial Solutions segment offers IT solutions that support various financial operation at financial institution and other companies. The Business Solutions segment provides human capital management and accounting management solutions. The Manufacturing Solutions segment develops performance evaluation methods for air mobility, researches and develops solutions in product lifecycle management.
